name: Response
description: A Message that answers a Request. A single Request may receive multiple Responses, including responses from several participants or successive responses from one participant. A Response does not by itself perform an operation unless its concrete type and enclosing document contracts define that behavior.

inResponseTo.description: Required correlation to the exact Coordination/Request occurrence answered by this Response.

type.name: Response Correlation
type.description: Correlation from a Response to the Request occurrence it answers.

incomingEvent.description: Pure { blueId: ... } reference to the exact Request occurrence. The Request payload is not embedded in the correlation object.
